# Use cases

Every business action is one use-case class: one actor intent, one entry point. Entry points (CLI, MCP, desktop) only call these.

| Use case | Module | What it does | Cited by |
|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="symbol-checkvaultupgrade"></a>[CheckVaultUpgrade](../../../src/vault/application/use-cases/check-vault-upgrade.use-case.ts) | vault | Describes a pending schema upgrade so a GUI confirmation screen can name it before running `migrate` — called only after `UnlockVault` has refused with `VAULT_UPGRADE_REQUIRED`. | — |
| <a id="symbol-createvault"></a>[CreateVault](../../../src/vault/application/use-cases/create-vault.use-case.ts) | vault | Creates the encrypted vault from a passphrase: mints its id and salt, derives the key, writes the header and database, and leaves it unlocked. | — |
| <a id="symbol-getcontextpack"></a>[GetContextPack](../../../src/context/application/use-cases/get-context-pack.use-case.ts) | context | — | — |
| <a id="symbol-importconversations"></a>[ImportConversations](../../../src/importers/application/use-cases/import-conversations.use-case.ts) | importers | Orchestrates an import: read the file, resolve a parser, parse to the normalized IR, select, chunk, and (unless listing or dry-running) hand the chunks to context's ImportItems for the single-session write. | — |
| <a id="symbol-importitems"></a>[ImportItems](../../../src/context/application/use-cases/import-items.use-case.ts) | context | Persist a batch of imported items in ONE session, auto-creating the target project. | — |
| <a id="symbol-listprojects"></a>[ListProjects](../../../src/context/application/use-cases/list-projects.use-case.ts) | context | — | — |
| <a id="symbol-lockvault"></a>[LockVault](../../../src/vault/application/use-cases/lock-vault.use-case.ts) | vault | Locks the vault by removing its key from the OS keychain, reporting the lineage and folder state for a clean hand-off to another device. | — |
| <a id="symbol-relocatevault"></a>[RelocateVault](../../../src/vault/application/use-cases/relocate-vault.use-case.ts) | vault | The file-move half of relocation (D-R(c) Option 1) — re-pointing already- connected AI clients is deliberately **not** this use case's job (D-R(a)'s "no use case calls another"); `desktop/.../relocation-handlers.ts` orchestrates that, strictly after this returns `ok`. | — |
| <a id="symbol-savecontext"></a>[SaveContext](../../../src/context/application/use-cases/save-context.use-case.ts) | context | — | — |
| <a id="symbol-searchcontext"></a>[SearchContext](../../../src/context/application/use-cases/search-context.use-case.ts) | context | — | — |
| <a id="symbol-showproject"></a>[ShowProject](../../../src/context/application/use-cases/show-project.use-case.ts) | context | — | — |
| <a id="symbol-unlockvault"></a>[UnlockVault](../../../src/vault/application/use-cases/unlock-vault.use-case.ts) | vault | Opens the vault: derives or accepts the key, gates a pending schema upgrade on consent, verifies the key against the database, stores it in the OS keychain and checks for a multi-device fork. | — |
| <a id="symbol-vaultstatus"></a>[VaultStatus](../../../src/vault/application/use-cases/vault-status.use-case.ts) | vault | Reports whether a vault exists, whether it is unlocked, its auto-lock state, lineage and folder safety signals — never its content. | — |
